Why This Role Is Important to Us The team you will be joining is part of Cyber Data & Analytics , a function that is vital to the company as it enables cybersecurity teams to make faster, data-driven decisions and strengthen the firm's ability to detect, investigate, and respond to evolving cyber threats. High-quality cybersecurity data is foundational to effective threat detection, incident response, risk reporting, observability, automation, and analytics. This role helps ensure that enterprise security telemetry is accurate , complete, searchable, and fit for purposes across cybersecurity platforms and data environments. What you will be responsible for As Junior SIEM Data Engineer you will: Support onboarding and validation of cybersecurity telemetry from enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud services, endpoints, identity systems, networks, and security platforms. Assist with analyzing source data structures, log formats, field availability, timestamp patterns, and metadata requirements. S upport data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, routing, and validation activities under the guidance of senior engineers. Help validate data quality across raw, enriched, curated, and analytics-ready data layers. Perform basic data checks for completeness, accuracy, freshness, schema consistency, duplicate records, timestamps, and field-level quali ty. Use query languages and analytical techniques to search, validate , compare, and troubleshoot security telemetry. Assist with identifying data gaps, missing fields, parsing issues, incorrect timestamps, routing issues, and inconsistencies between source and destination data. Support documentation of data source requirements, field mappings, data flow diagrams, transformation logic, validation results, and operational runbooks. Work with cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, application, and data engineering teams to understand data requirements and support issue resolution. Participate in operational support activities such as ticket updates, issue tracking, testing, validation evidence, handoffs, and root cause documentation. Support second-line troubleshooting for data engineering jobs, pipelines, and data delivery issues impacting cyber data platforms, under the guidance of senior engineers. What we value These skills will help you succeed in this role: Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and willingness to learn security data engineering concepts. Foundational understanding of data engineering, data analytics, cybersecurity, information systems, or cloud computing concepts. Basic knowledge of data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, validation, data quality, and data documentation practices. Ability to use query languages or scripting concepts to analyze, validate , and troubleshoot data. Strong communication , documentation, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with geographically distributed teams. Education & Requirement This role may follow a hybrid work model, with in-office presence required based on team, business, and location expectations. Flexibility may be required for occasional operational support, release of activities, incident resolution, escalation support, or data delivery of recovery efforts.
